keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Penalty saved. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal by Senne Lammens (Manchester United).
Senne Lammens (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 1, Manchester United 0. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Youri Tielemans (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Gonçalo Inácio (Sporting Lisbon).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Sporting Lisbon 1, Manchester United 0.
Second Half begins Sporting Lisbon 1, Manchester United 0.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 1, Manchester United 1. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 1, Manchester United 2. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) left footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Amad Diallo.
Eduardo Quaresma (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Manchester United. Patrick Dorgu replaces Joshua Zirkzee.
Substitution, Manchester United. Diogo Dalot replaces Noussair Mazraoui.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Rodrigo Zalazar replaces Geny Catamo.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Nestory Irankunda replaces Issa Doumbia.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Ibrahima Ba replaces Eduardo Quaresma.
Substitution, Manchester United. Shea Lacey replaces Amad Diallo because of an injury.
Goal! Sporting Lisbon 2, Manchester United 2. Luis Suárez (Sporting Lisbon) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Sporting Lisbon. Fotis Ioannidis replaces Luis Suárez.
Nestory Irankunda (Sporting Lisbon) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Manchester United. Mason Mount replaces Bryan Mbeumo.
Substitution, Manchester United. Andrey Santos replaces Bruno Fernandes.
Second yellow card to Youri Tielemans (Manchester United) for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Sporting Lisbon 2, Manchester United 2.
